question: The Hawa Mahal in Jaipur was built by which of the following kings?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sawai Pratap Singh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hawa Mahal was built in **Jaipur **by **Sawai Pratap Singh**.
 
• **Hawa Mahal **was built in the year **1799.**
 
• **Sawai Pratap Singh **was the Grandson of **Sawai Jai Singh**.
 
• **Jaipur **is the current capital of **Rajasthan, **Jaipur was built in 1727 AD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hawa Mahal is **referred to as the 'Palace of Winds'.
 
• **Important facts about hawa Mahal:__**
 
 
• ​Shaped like a Crown. 
 
• The Wind Palace. 
 
• Built for the Royal Ladies. 
 
• Looks like a Honey Comb.
 
• No Front Entrance.
 
• No Stairs to Reach the Upper Floors. 
 
• Named after Hawa Mandir.
